description: This file defines and manages a set of common initialisms (acronyms) used in code, including functions for initializing, adding, and checking initialisms, as well as sorting and storing them in a thread-safe manner.

classes.name: indexOfInitialisms
classes.description: A thread-safe, sortable index of initialisms implemented with sync.Map and mutex for concurrency control.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a map of initialisms into the index, returning the index instance.

methods.name: isInitialism
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a recognized initialism.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new initialism to the index.

methods.name: sorted
methods.description: Returns a sorted slice of all initialisms in the index.
